column1: # Licenses allowed in lib/ of the TapCue distribution (STEP-06; docs/LICENSE-AUDIT.md §3).
# scripts/fork/check-licenses.py compares every license in THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md §1 with this file. A license string
# that is not listed here fails the check: a new dependency, or a new version declaring its license differently, needs
# a reviewed entry first. Strings are matched exactly, as the POM declares them ("name (url)").
#   allowed           may be the only license of a library
#   alternative-only  allowed only as one of several licenses the library offers, next to an allowed one
#                     (TapCue then uses the allowed one, e.g. JNA: LGPL-2.1 or Apache-2.0 -> Apache-2.0)

column3: Public Domain, per Creative Commons CC0 (http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/)
